candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits are not recorded in Acc[msg.sender].balance.
Set unlockTime unconditionally to _unlockTime instead of clamping to at least block.timestamp, changing the stored unlock time observable via Acc(msg.sender).
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so a Put no longer appends a message to the Log's History.
Drop the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put, allowing reentrant calls into Put.
Remove `locked_ = true;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the guard never engages, allowing reentrancy observable at the public surface.
Remove the `require(!locked_);` check from the nonReentrant_ modifier so reentrant calls are no longer blocked.
